title: Principal ServiceNow Architect – ITSM & Enterprise Workflow
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Principal ServiceNow Architect to lead the architecture, solution design, technical governance, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions. The individual will be responsible for translating business and IT requirements into secure, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly platform capabilities aligned with ITIL best practices and enterprise architecture standards.

The role requires a strong combination of ServiceNow platform expertise, hands-on technical proficiency, ITSM process knowledge, integration architecture, and stakeholder management. The candidate must be capable of independently handling complex technical challenges, evaluating existing implementations, identifying architectural gaps, and driving solutions from design through deployment and operational support.

The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, ITSM process owners, platform administrators, developers, integration teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and delivery leadership.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise and Solution Architecture**

Define the ServiceNow platform architecture, technical standards, design principles, and implementation guidelines.

Translate business requirements and functional specifications into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.

Lead architecture assessments, solution design reviews, technical feasibility assessments, and architectural decision-making.

Evaluate out-of-the-box capabilities against customization requirements and prioritize configuration over custom development wherever feasible.

Define reusable architectural patterns, application boundaries, data models, and integration approaches.

Maintain architecture documentation, solution design documents, technical specifications, and architecture decision records.

Assess existing implementations to identify technical debt, architectural inconsistencies, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. ITSM and ITIL Process Architecture**

Design and govern ServiceNow ITSM capabilities, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Request Management, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog.

Align platform workflows with ITIL 4 principles and enterprise service management policies.

Review and optimize incident categorization, impact, urgency, priority, assignment rules, escalation, and SLA management.

Define appropriate priority calculation and escalation models, ensuring that business impact and urgency drive consistent prioritization.

Establish standards for incident lifecycle management, major incident handling, problem investigation, change risk assessment, approvals, and service restoration.

Ensure that process implementations are consistent, measurable, auditable, and aligned with operational objectives.

Challenge unnecessary customizations or process variations that increase complexity without delivering measurable business value.

**3. Technical Architecture and Advanced Development**

Provide technical leadership for complex ServiceNow implementations, custom applications, workflows, and platform enhancements.

Demonstrate strong hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAggregate, GlideSystem, GlideAjax, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Flow Designer.

Design and troubleshoot advanced automation, event-driven processing, asynchronous operations, and complex workflow logic.

Define appropriate use of IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, scripting, scheduled jobs, events, and platform-native capabilities.

Review code for quality, security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow development standards.

Diagnose complex defects, production incidents, transaction failures, slow-running scripts, and unexpected platform behavior.

Establish development standards, code review practices, reusable components, and technical documentation.

**4. Integration and Data Architecture**

Design and govern integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other supported integration mechanisms.

Define authentication, authorization, API security, error handling, retry mechanisms, monitoring, and integration resiliency.

Lead integration design across identity management, monitoring tools, ERP, CRM, HR, cloud platforms, and other enterprise applications.

Establish data ownership, data mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and validation standards.

Govern CMDB data integrations, identification and reconciliation rules, and data quality where applicable.

Troubleshoot integration failures, authentication issues, data inconsistencies, API errors, and performance constraints.

**5. Platform Governance, Security, and Performance**

Establish platform governance, development lifecycle standards, application access controls, and technical quality gates.

Ensure appropriate use of roles, ACLs, authentication, authorization, encryption, and sensitive-data controls.

Define instance strategy, application scope, update-set or application deployment practices, and environment promotion controls.

Establish release, upgrade, regression-testing, and rollback strategies in collaboration with platform operations.

Assess customization impact on upgrades and minimize upgrade conflicts.

Monitor platform health, transaction performance, script efficiency, integration reliability, and technical debt.

Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies, audit requirements, and applicable governance standards.

**6. CMDB, Service Mapping, and ITOM**

Define CMDB architecture, configuration item classes, relationships, ownership, and data quality controls.

Establish configuration management standards and alignment between business services, technical services, and supporting infrastructure.

Provide architectural guidance for Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and operational visibility where these capabilities are in scope.

Define integration patterns for infrastructure monitoring and service health data.

Ensure that CMDB and operational data support incident impact analysis, change risk assessment, and service availability objectives.

**7. ServiceNow Product and Platform Strategy**

Evaluate and recommend appropriate ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, ITOM, IT Asset Management, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Security Operations, and Integrated Risk Management, according to business needs.

Assess product fit, licensing implications, implementation complexity, dependencies, and business value.

Identify opportunities to consolidate fragmented workflows and reduce overlapping tools or custom-built solutions.

Define platform evolution roadmaps, capability maturity improvements, and modernization priorities.

Stay current with relevant ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, architecture guidance, and recommended practices.

**8. Delivery Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product managers, project managers, and delivery teams to establish solution scope and technical priorities.

Lead architecture workshops, technical design discussions, proof-of-concept exercises, and solution demonstrations.

Provide technical direction and mentoring to developers, administrators, technical leads, and implementation partners.

Review estimates, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and implementation plans.

Support testing strategy, defect triage, deployment readiness, go-live, and post-production stabilization.

Communicate architectural decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

12–15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial hands-on ServiceNow experience.

Typically 8+ years of ServiceNow implementation and development experience, including significant ownership of complex technical solutions.

Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade ServiceNow architectures.

Strong knowledge of ITSM processes and ITIL principles; ITIL 4 certification is preferred.

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification; relevant implementation and architect-level certifications are strongly preferred.

Strong JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting expertise, including complex debugging and code reviews.

Proven experience with REST/SOAP integrations, authentication, data transformation, and integration troubleshooting.

Experience with platform security, access controls, performance optimization, release management, and upgrades.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Ability to work independently, make architecture decisions, explain technical trade-offs, and take ownership of complex issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification.

Relevant ServiceNow CIS certifications, particularly ITSM and ITOM where applicable.

ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect or Certified Master Architect credentials, where held and relevant to the role.

Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, service management governance, and technical debt reduction.

Experience leading multi-team implementations, platform modernization, and enterprise integration programs.

**Expected Outcomes**

A clearly defined, documented, and governed ServiceNow architecture.

Consistent implementation of ITSM processes aligned with business policies and ITIL principles.

Improved platform stability, integration reliability, maintainability, and upgrade readiness.

Reduced unnecessary customization, technical debt, recurring defects, and avoidable production incidents.

Stronger code quality, security controls, documentation, and deployment governance.

A prioritized platform improvement roadmap tied to measurable business and operational outcomes.

title: VP - Business Manager
description:
**Job Title: VP\- Business Manager**


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected, and opinions count. We foster continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. As part of the Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function, you’ll play a vital role in supporting HSBC’s second line of defence, ensuring robust risk management and operational excellence across the Group.


The Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function is HSBC’s Second Line of Defence, responsible for reviewing and challenging the activities of the Group’s businesses to ensure effective risk management. With a global headcount of \~14,000 and annual costs of \~$1\.5bn, R\&C is evolving its operating model, requiring robust oversight, administration, and management. This role is pivotal in supporting the R\&C CAO CoE, driving operational excellence, and enabling strategic objectives in a dynamic, highly scrutinized environment. The role holder needs to understand the impact of all these changes on Risk \& Compliance and HSBC and support the Global R\&C COO, Global R\&C CAO and Head CAO CoE as necessary. The role holder will be required to interact with many internal and external parties at the highest level of management and therefore needs an outstanding level of professionalism and gravitas.As a Senior Business Manager within the R\&C CoE, you will be a strategic partner to Lines of Business and Global R\&C Sub\-functions, helping leaders turn centrally produced financial, workforce and performance data into clear decisions and practical action. You will connect insight with business context, identify risks and opportunities, generate ideas to improve performance and help shape priorities across the function.Reporting to the R\&C Head of CAO CoE India, you will work with global, regional and business stakeholders to translate information into a compelling performance story, challenge assumptions and coordinate delivery. Financial analysis and tracking remain important; however, the core data and reporting are produced centrally. Your value will come from interpreting what the data means, asking the right questions and enabling timely, well\-informed choices.


The ideal candidate will combine strong business judgement, curiosity and influencing skills with an understanding of risk management and organisational performance. They will be comfortable leading a team, navigating a global matrix and moving stakeholders from insight to action.

**In this role, you will:**


The role holder will share good practice globally, lead a team and build trusted relationships across the function. Key responsibilities include:

* Partner with the Global R\&C CAO wider team and senior leaders to understand priorities, performance and delivery challenges across assigned Lines of Business and Global Sub\-functions.Use centrally produced financial, workforce and performance information to build a clear view of what is changing, why it matters and where leadership action is required.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging themes, connecting information across teams to generate ideas for improved performance, effectiveness and service delivery.Challenge assumptions and test whether plans, resources and investments remain aligned to business priorities.
* Use scenario analysis to explore choices, trade\-offs and potential outcomes for the relevant Sub\-function or Line of Business.
* Support decisions on consultancy, third\-party spend, hiring and out\-of\-plan requirements by assessing business need, value and alignment to priorities.Track agreed actions and outcomes, helping leaders understand whether interventions are delivering the intended impact.
* Support senior leaders across Lines of Business and Sub\-functions with integrated business management covering performance, people, priorities, governance and organisational effectiveness.Create clear leadership narratives from centrally produced Management Information, focusing discussion on decisions, actions and opportunities rather than reporting alone.
* Coordinate business planning and governance rhythms, ensuring priorities, dependencies and actions remain visible and connected.Coordinate and execute the business change and organisational design activity required to deliver the agreed financial resource plan, across both cost and FTE
* Build trusted relationships with R\&C leadership and partners across the Global Businesses, Global Functions, Finance and HR.Facilitate constructive, evidence\-based conversations that help stakeholders align on priorities and make timely decisions.
* Bring together perspectives from global and regional stakeholders to spot themes, share learning and scale effective ideas.Provide constructive challenge to existing practices and proposed initiatives, developing practical solutions to complex issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve value, simplify activity and redirect resources to the areas of greatest strategic importance.
* Lead, coach and develop direct reports, creating clear priorities and promoting curiosity, collaboration and high\-quality delivery.Support effective performance, talent and succession management across the team

**To be successful you will:**

**Knowledge \& Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of business management, organisational performance and strategy execution.
* Ability to interpret financial, workforce and operational information and connect it to business context and decisions.Sound understanding of the external banking environment, including regulatory, political and competitive factors.
* Strong awareness of internal control, operational risk and the role of Risk \& Compliance.
* Awareness of data governance and the importance of reliable, consistent information for decision\-making.Demonstrated success in using business, financial, workforce or operational insight to influence senior decisions and improve outcomes.Experience turning complex data and competing viewpoints into clear narratives, options and recommendations.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, generate practical ideas and lead performance or organisational improvement.
* Experience working with central Finance, HR or data teams and applying their outputs within a business context.
* Strong stakeholder management experience in a complex, global matrix organisation.Experience shaping and delivering people, capability or engagement plans across diverse teams.
* Experience coordinating and executing business change and organisational design activity to deliver cost and FTE plans.Strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to connect insight to business priorities.Intellectual curiosity and confidence asking questions that uncover the story behind the data.
* Ability to spot patterns, risks and opportunities and develop practical ideas in response.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and influencing skills, including with senior stakeholders.Strong leadership, collaboration and facilitation skills.
* Comfort interpreting data and scenarios without needing to own the underlying financial production processes.
* Proactive, resilient and effective in a fast\-moving international environment.Outstanding organisational and problem management skills, and extensive project and programme management exposure

The Employee Life Cycle (ELC) Specialist plays a critical role in maintaining and managing employee data integrity within the organization. This position requires a detail\-oriented individual with a strong focus on accuracy and the ability to handle sensitive information confidentially. The role involves collaborative efforts with various departments to ensure smooth and precise data management, including position management, offboarding, and absence tracking.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------



1\. Data Integrity and Management

requests, employment confirmation letters, mass data updates, data corrections, and  

employment probation confirmation.  

Ensure all transactions are completed within the SLA and payroll cut\-off dates.  

Conduct regular audits to verify data accuracy and consistency across various systems.  

 Demonstrate a methodical and organized approach to work situations with high attention to  

detail.

Ensure compliance with data governance, company policies and legal requirements  

during the process.  

Perform post upload validations.

  

4\. Compliance and Confidentiality

and company policies.  

Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and internal data management guidelines.

  

5\. Interdepartmental Collaboration  

 Work closely with HR and payroll to resolve any discrepancies in employee data.  

Collaborate with other departments to ensure accurate and timely data management.

  

6\. Process Improvement  

 Identify and suggest improvements in data management processes to enhance efficiency  

and accuracy.  

Engage in HR system improvement projects or data migration activities.

  

  

7\. Query Management  

Respond to data\-related queries from employees and management in a timely and  

professional manner.  

Provide support and guidance on data management best practices.

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and integrity.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Data and Analytics, HR Process Improvement; Process management; HR Process improvement, Storytelling; Data led storytelling, Strategic mindset, Digital literacy, HR Data Analsyis; Data management; Employee data management, Commercial accumen, Solutioning.**What we offer**

title: Head HR

Job Role: HEAD \- HR

Position Overview

This position will lead the Human Resources function of the school, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements, smooth operational support, and a strong focus on employee engagement. This role is pivotal in aligning HR practices with the institution’s mission of academic excellence and fostering a positive, inclusive workplace culture. This position will report to CEO and the school level reporting to HOS (Head of School).

Key Responsibilities1\. **Human Resources Management**

* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and induction processes for teaching and non‑teaching staff.
* Develop and implement HR policies, SOPs, and performance management systems.
* Manage payroll, compensation, benefits, and leave administration.
* Ensure timely handling of employee grievances and disciplinary matters.

2\. **Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to labor laws, education board regulations, and institutional policies.
* Maintain accurate employee records and statutory registers.
* Coordinate audits, inspections, and compliance reporting (PF, ESI, gratuity, etc.).
* Stay updated on evolving HR and education‑sector regulations.

3\. **Operations Support**

* Collaborate with the administration team on school operations, including scheduling, logistics, and event planning.
* Support crisis management and contingency planning.
* Assist in vendor management and procurement processes where HR intersects with operations.

4\. **Employee Engagement \& Development**

* Design and implement employee engagement initiatives to boost morale and retention.
* Organize training, workshops, and professional development programs.
* Foster a culture of appreciation, inclusivity, and continuous improvement.
* Lead communication strategies to ensure transparency and trust among staff.

5\. **Strategic Contribution**

* Partner with senior leadership to align HR strategies with institutional goals.
* Contribute to succession planning and talent development.
* Provide insights on workforce trends, benchmarking, and institutional competitiveness.

Desired Qualifications \& Skills

* Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field.
* 8–15 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in education or service‑oriented sectors.
* Strong knowledge of statutory compliance and labor laws.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to balance operational efficiency with employee well‑being.

As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).


‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency


Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**  

Onboarding Experience Partner \- End\-to\-End Onboarding \& Day 1 Experience

  

We are looking for a proactive, empathetic, and detail\-oriented professional to serve as the single point of contact for candidates throughout their onboarding journey, from Interview Selection to successful Day 1 Onboarding and Reporting.


The role is responsible for managing the complete candidate onboarding lifecycle, including candidate engagement, offer acceptance support, onboarding coordination, Background Verification , Pre\-Medical management, Joining \& Relocation, Day 1 induction readiness, compliance governance, and employee experience management to ensure a seamless, compliant, and engaging onboarding experience.


Key Responsibilities


End\-to\-End Onboarding Ownership

* Own the complete onboarding lifecycle from interview selection to Day 1 reporting.
* Serve as the dedicated SPOC for candidates throughout their onboarding journey.
* Proactively engage with candidates to drive readiness, confidence, and joining commitment.
* Ensure timely completion of all onboarding milestones and compliance requirements.


Candidate Experience \& Engagement

* Build meaningful relationships with candidates and provide personalized support.
* Drive a best\-in\-class onboarding experience that strengthens employer brand perception.
* Identify and mitigate risks that could impact candidate joining.
* Support offer acceptance, relocation, joining formalities, and pre\-joining queries.


Operational Excellence \& Governance

* Manage Background Verification , Pre\-Medical, documentation, and onboarding compliance processes.
* Track onboarding readiness and maintain governance dashboards and trackers.
* Monitor onboarding SLAs and ensure timely closure of activities.
* Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to resolve bottlenecks and escalations.


Day 1 Experience Management

* Ensure complete Day 1 readiness, including system access, assets, workspace, and induction arrangements.
* Facilitate virtual and in\-person Day 1 induction programs.
* Troubleshoot onboarding issues and drive timely resolution.
* Deliver a smooth and memorable first\-day employee experience.


Stakeholder Management

* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Hiring Managers, IT, Facilities, Security, Payroll, Finance, Admin, Vendors, and Business Leaders.
* Provide onboarding insights, updates, and risk assessments to stakeholders.
* Influence decisions and drive accountability across cross\-functional teams.


Continuous Improvement

* Identify process gaps and recommend automation and experience enhancement opportunities.
* Analyze onboarding metrics and trends to improve candidate conversion and onboarding effectiveness.
* Contribute to transformation and employee experience initiatives.


What We're Looking For


Essential Skills

* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and risk\-management capabilities.
* High attention to detail and process orientation.
* Passion for employee and candidate experience.


Preferred Experience

* Experience in End\-to\-End Onboarding, HR Operations, Candidate Experience, Recruitment Coordination, Employee Experience, or Shared Services Operations.
* Familiarity with BGV, Pre\-Medical, Documentation, Joining Formalities, Day 1 Induction, and HR compliance processes.
* Hands\-on experience with HR systems and onboarding platforms.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.


Qualifications

title: Senior Learning Measurement Analyst
description:
**Job Description:**  

Job Purpose/Overview
  
  

The Senior Learning Measurement Analyst plays a pivotal role within Mars University’s Learning Measurement team, supporting the team by managing data, analysis, and reporting to evaluate the impact of learning programs. This role combines data transformation with visualization, applying analytical techniques where appropriate to create visibility to learning effectiveness and business value. The analyst collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, optimize reporting processes, and deliver insights that drive continuous improvement.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Operations Automation: Own the design and delivery of scalable reports and dashboards that support core learning operations (e.g., nominations, demand planning, evaluations). Continuously improve the data ecosystem by automating, standardizing, and optimizing reporting processes to enhance data usability and reduce manual effort.
* Program Portfolio Measurement: Support measurement efforts for priority learning programs, including KPI development, pre\- and post\-training assessment analysis, and summarizing key takeaways. Lead data support for new initiatives, such as pilots and new program launches.
* Insights Added Business Value: Take a consultative approach to data requests, helping stakeholders define their needs and shaping solutions that add strategic value. Investigate and resolve data discrepancies or broken reports independently, setting up new methods when standard procedures do not apply.
* Mentorship Partnership: Serve as a technical mentor and thought partner for colleagues within the Learning Measurement team. Act as a key liaison with partners across MGS Learning, PO, and Functional teams to deliver accurate, relevant data and represent the Learning Measurement Strategy.
* Governance Documentation: Promote best practices in data protection, documentation, and quality control. Maintain clear documentation on how reports are built, where numbers come from, and what definitions are used.


Context and Scope
  
  

This role operates within the global Learning Measurement team, managing data projects from intake through to delivery with a high degree of autonomy. The analyst will partner closely with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders across different segments of the business, translating technical findings into business\-relevant recommendations. The position requires a structured, problem\-solving mindset to uncover new and less obvious solutions that drive stakeholder impact.
  
  

Job Specifications/Qualifications
  
  

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 years of experience in data and reporting
  
  

Knowledge / Experience
  
  

* Strong practical experience preparing, cleaning, and combining data from multiple sources (such as SQL, Excel, or automated data flows)
* Ability to run basic and intermediate statistical summaries (such as averages, standard deviations, distributions, and pre/post score comparisons) to find key insights and explain trends
* Proven ability to build and maintain clean, easy\-to\-use dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools
* Ability to identify unusual data issues, find where things went wrong, and fix them independently
* Experience supporting junior colleagues, helping them troubleshoot data issues and checking work for quality and accuracy
* Experience finding manual or repetitive reporting steps and making them simpler or automated
* Clear verbal and written English skills to explain data findings simply to colleagues and stakeholders
* Experienced in digital fluency and demonstrated curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies including AI to drive innovation and continuous improvement
* Experience in working with learning or HR data (e.g., training completions, program effectiveness, people data) is preferred.

title: Manager - Executive Recruitments
description:

Providence, one of the US’s largest not\-for\-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.


Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000\+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.


Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2\.0\. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In\-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation
**The Opportunity**


We are looking for an exemplary Manager / Senior Manager \- Executive Recruitment (Technology) to drive leadership hiring across key technology functions. This role will focus on identifying, engaging, and hiring senior technology talent at the Director, Senior Director, and critical niche leadership levels.

  

The ideal candidate will bring strong executive recruiting expertise, deep understanding of technology talent markets, and the ability to partner with business leaders to deliver high\-quality leadership hiring outcomes. The role requires a blend of executive search, talent mapping, stakeholder management, and market intelligence capabilities.

  

**Leadership Hiring**

**Talent Mapping \& Market Intelligence**


* Conduct talent research and competitive intelligence to identify leadership talent across the market.
* Develop organizational and competitor mappings to support strategic hiring initiatives.
* Provide insights on talent availability, market trends, and competitive landscapes.
* Support workforce planning through external talent intelligence and succession insights.
  

**Stakeholder Management**


* Collaborate with Technology Leaders, HR Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition leadership.
* Act as a trusted recruiting partner to hiring teams throughout the search process.
* Facilitate candidate assessments, interview debriefs, and selection decisions.

**Sourcing Excellence**


* Leverage executive search methodologies and external networks to identify top talent.
* Create innovative sourcing strategies for hard\-to\-find technology leaders.
* Build long\-term relationships with passive candidates and industry networks.
* Maintain talent communities for recurring and future hiring needs.
  

**Process \& Governance**


* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and processes.
* Monitor recruitment metrics including time\-to\-fill, pipeline quality, and hiring effectiveness.
* + Partner with recruitment operations and stakeholders to drive continuous process improvements.
	+ Support diversity\-focused hiring initiatives and inclusive recruiting practices.**Education**

	+ Experience recruiting Director, Senior Director, and niche technical leadership talent.
	+ Exposure to global hiring and stakeholder management preferred.

title: CTK Svc Associate
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  

  

About Amazon Centralized Timekeeping  

  

The vision of the Centralized Timekeeping team is to utilize top talent to streamline time and attendance data entry, reduce payroll defects and provide consistently high service levels. Today, CTK supports and manages time and attendance matters for thousands of Amazon Associates. Requests for edits are submitted via trouble ticketing from operators and HR across the network. The Centralized team manages the ticket queue by executing on the requests on a FIFO basis but will prioritize any payroll impacting ticket if there is a risk of a payroll defect. The efforts of this team support the business by ensuring associate’s time and attendance matters are handled with speed, precision and with customer obsession always in mind.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or Advanced Degree
* Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis
* Experience working in a large team or fast\-paced corporate environment, or experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
* Experience owning end\-to\-end programs to drive results

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with Windows, Word, Excel, MyTime (Kronos) and PowerPoint
* Experience in administrative tasks such as data entry, managing data driven report processes or processes
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience with MS Office Suite, CRMs (Salesforce) and other systems
* 6\+ months of human resources experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
